disciplines.name: Smithing
disciplines.description: Shape hot metal with hammer and anvil.

gates.description: Practise smithing for 30 days.
Complete a seasonal cycle with at least 91 days of careful smithing (care ≥70%).
Three years of smithing; key attribute ≥12.
Complete a smithing task yielding at least 120% of its base.
Learn smithing from a level-30 teacher, or gain an insight.
Ten years of smithing, an insight and key attribute ≥14.
Qi from cultivation or sustained spirit resources.
An insight, a life-defining work and cultivation realm 2 (future).
An insight, a life-defining work and cultivation realm 3 (future).
